name: Kayneth Stillwind
summary: Sentinel Shindrell Swiftfire sends a courier east from Astranaar with a scouting missive for Forest Song. Druid Kayneth Stillwind needs help watching corruption spread through Ashenvale's ancient woods.

sections.title: A Dispatch to the East
sections.body: In Astranaar, Sentinel Shindrell Swiftfire watches over western Ashenvale. Druid Kayneth Stillwind, stationed at Forest Song in the forest's eastern reaches, has asked her to assess the region's security. Shifting wildlife and dark omens along the coasts and through the woods trouble him. Swiftfire puts her observations in a sealed note, trusting a traveler to carry it safely across the dangerous central forest.

sections.title: Watchers at Forest Song
sections.body: The way to Forest Song crosses Nightsong Woods, where satyrs encroach, wildlife turns hostile, and the Horde makes excursions from the south. At Forest Song's shrine, Kayneth Stillwind studies the balance of Ashenvale's natural spirits. Swiftfire's reconnaissance confirms his fear that corruption is spreading through the forest, not confined to one place or passing quickly. The druids will need more help to confront the wickedness taking root.

faq.answer: Kayneth Stillwind is at Forest Song, a night elf sanctuary in Nightsong Woods, far east in Ashenvale and north of the main road.
Sentinel Shindrell Swiftfire offers it from Astranaar, the night elf settlement in western Ashenvale.
Shindrell's Note reports security conditions along Ashenvale's western coast and around Astranaar's woodlands, helping Kayneth Stillwind investigate unnatural corruption in the forest.

faq.q: Why is Kayneth Stillwind investigating the forest?
faq.answer: Kayneth Stillwind investigates because he fears a pervasive wickedness is spreading through Ashenvale. As a druid, he seeks reports from the Sentinels to learn where it is taking hold and uphold nature's balance.

faq.q: Is Forest Song safe for Alliance travelers?
faq.answer: Forest Song is a peaceful Alliance refuge with friendly sentinels and druids. Hostile beasts and corrupted satyrs threaten the surrounding Nightsong Woods, making the journey hazardous.

faq.q: What happens after delivering the note?
faq.answer: After reviewing Shindrell's report, Kayneth investigates the forest's corruption and enlists travelers to act against the blighted forces threatening the region.

angles.text: As a druid, you answer a calling by helping Kayneth Stillwind and the Cenarion Circle heal Ashenvale from spreading demonic and elemental blights.
As a night elf, you share with the Sentinels a duty to keep communication open between Astranaar and distant holdings like Forest Song.
As an Alliance traveler, you help maintain communication and defense across Ashenvale, from its center to eastern Nightsong Woods, against wilderness threats and Horde incursions.
